name: run-ledger
description: Sub-agent model allocation: live agent graph, model routing (local or Jev), context exchange and API-rate costs

jevEndpoint.title: Jev adapter URL
jevEndpoint.description: HTTP endpoint that answers run-ledger's recommendation request (see README). Empty: Jev is off and makes zero calls.

routing.title: Routing mode
routing.description: recommend: only show Jev's recommendation. auto: also apply it to eligible subagents.

autoRouteTypes.title: Auto-routing eligible agent types
autoRouteTypes.description: Comma-separated subagent types auto mode may reroute (e.g. Explore). *: every type. Empty: none.

jevModels.title: Models offered to Jev
jevModels.description: Comma-separated model ids Jev may choose from. Empty: the current models in the price table.

budgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD, API-rate estimate)
budgetUsd.description: Sent to Jev as the budget. 0: no budget.

jevTimeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
jevTimeoutMs.description: How long a spawn waits for Jev before it falls back to the engine's own choice.

roles.title: Register routing roles
roles.description: Registers five subagent roles (orchestrator, builder, implementer, executor, iterator) that the router assigns models to.

band.title: Context exchange band
band.description: auto: while Claude works and two minutes after. always: whenever the run has context. off: never.

logDecisions.title: Log routing decisions
logDecisions.description: Writes one dim transcript line per routing decision (not sent to the model).

autoOpen.title: Open the pane on the first subagent
autoOpen.description: Opens the run-ledger pane when the session's first subagent starts.

baselineModel.title: Savings baseline model
baselineModel.description: The model 'routing saved' compares against: the same tokens priced as if everything ran on it.

graphics.title: Terminal graphics
graphics.description: auto: real pixels on terminals that draw images (Ghostty, kitty; not inside tmux), braille elsewhere. pixels: always try pixels. braille: always braille.

pixelDensity.title: Pixel density
pixelDensity.description: Pixels per point for the pictures: 2 for Retina screens, 1 for standard ones (from 1 to 3). Lower costs less CPU.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: neon (bright, glowing), minimal (muted, little glow), contrast (high contrast), light (for a light terminal). auto: light where the terminal reports a light background (COLORFGBG), else neon.

receipt.title: Receipt when a run ends
receipt.description: A few dim transcript lines (never sent to the model) with the run's models, cost and savings. subagents: for runs that spawned subagents. always: every run. off: never.

sound.title: Sound when a run ends
sound.description: A short chime when a run with subagents ends (a lower one if something failed). macOS plays it; other systems have no player.

intro.title: Opening animation
intro.description: When the pane opens, nodes appear level by level and the roster cascades in.
